summary: This is a Mol Labs public hypothesis card (P17) proposing an assay to test whether residual pAMPK/pACC (or AICAR) persists under folate-repletion conditions that abolish MOTS-c-enhanced glycolysis, framed as an "assumption-kill" for the one-carbon/de novo purine pathway hypothesis. The experiment has NOT been run; all key readouts are UNKNOWN or PREDICTION. The document synthesizes prior literature (Lee 2015, Cabreiro 2013, Corominas-Faja 2012, Pirkmajer 2015) as class priors but identifies a gap: no matched residual H2H panel exists.

content_blocks.title: Hypothesis / Claim (P17)
content_blocks.content: On a matched MOTS-c ± folate-repletion panel in MOTS-c-ST cells (or exogenous MOTS-c) with glycolysis QC plus pAMPK Thr172 / pACC Ser79 (or AICAR) and AMP/ATP: under folate repletion that abolishes MOTS-c-enhanced glycolysis, residual pAMPK/pACC (or AICAR) remains ≥50% of the MOTS-c without-folate-repletion arm on the same panel (named comparator = MOTS-c unrepleted arm under matched AMP/ATP). This is framed as an 'assumption-kill / one-carbon-insufficiency' test.

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: MOTS-c is proposed to inhibit the folate cycle and de novo purine biosynthesis, causing AICAR accumulation and AMPK/pACC activation even while AMP falls and ATP rises. Folate media supplementation reverses the MOTS-c-enhanced glycolytic response (Lee 2015). P17 asks whether residual pAMPK/pACC/AICAR under folate repletion (which abolishes glycolysis enhancement) still requires the one-carbon/de novo purine path rather than AMP/ATP energy-charge AMPK. Adjacent class priors: Cabreiro (metformin–microbial folate–host one-carbon), Corominas-Faja (metformin antifolate-class fingerprint, thymidine+hypoxanthine blocks ATM/AMPK), Pirkmajer (MTX/ATIC slows ZMP metabolism, lowers AICAR–AMPK threshold). None score MOTS-c residual under folate repletion that abolishes glycolysis.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary
content_blocks.content:
1. Lee 2015 (PMID 25738459, Cell Metab): MOTS-c inhibits folate cycle and tethered de novo purine → AICAR → AMPK/pACC despite AMP↓ATP↑; folate media supplementation reverses MOTS-c-enhanced glycolysis. NOT a residual-under-repletion H2H.
2. Cabreiro 2013 (PMID 23540700, Cell): Metformin alters microbial folate and methionine metabolism → host one-carbon/methionine restriction. Adjacent one-carbon prior; NOT MOTS-c residual H2H.
3. Corominas-Faja 2012 (PMID 22837425, Aging): Metformin impairs one-carbon/folate flow similar to antifolates; AMPK secondary to one-carbon alteration; thymidine+hypoxanthine blocks metformin ATM/AMPK. Adjacent antifolate-class prior; NOT MOTS-c residual H2H.
4. Pirkmajer 2015 (PMID 25338814, Diabetes): MTX inhibits ATIC → slows ZMP/AICAR metabolism → lowers threshold for AICAR-induced AMPK in skeletal muscle/myotubes. Antifolate/de novo purine → AICAR → AMPK class prior; NOT MOTS-c × folate-repletion residual panel.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Assay / Method
content_blocks.content: Method type: propose-assay. Preferred system: MOTS-c-ST cells or exogenous MOTS-c cell panel (cell panel preferred before animal/human). Required readouts: pAMPK Thr172, pACC Ser79 (or AICAR), AMP/ATP ratio, glycolysis QC (must confirm folate repletion abolishes MOTS-c-enhanced glycolysis). Optional controls: AMPK KD / compound C / AICAR-path control. Threshold: residual pAMPK/pACC (or AICAR) ≥50% of MOTS-c unrepleted arm under matched AMP/ATP. Execution status: NOT_RUN.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered matched MOTS-c ± folate-repletion panel where folate repletion abolishes MOTS-c-enhanced glycolysis, residual pAMPK/pACC (or AICAR) is <50% of the MOTS-c without-folate-repletion arm under that same condition — so energy-charge / glycolysis-coupled AMPK framing survives and one-carbon-insufficiency residual fails — when incomplete folate repletion, glycolysis-not-abolished, absent residual, or AMP/ATP QC artifacts are ruled out.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. P1–P16 do not prove P17; P2 left host folate-status × ΔpACC UNKNOWN as biomarker-bridge; that emptiness is not a residual-under-folate-repletion H2H.
2. Skip-list / series distinctness: do not collapse to OpenLabs BPC orthosteric dialect, P15 residual-FBXO22, or P16 LKKTETQ-Cc; NOT FOXO4×LOF (SERIES_FROZEN).
3. Lee glycolysis rescue ≠ residual pAMPK/pACC panel; Cabreiro/Corominas-Faja/Pirkmajer lack MOTS-c residual-under-repletion arm; incomplete folate repletion / glycolysis-not-abolished / no residual to score / AMP-ATP QC failure leave the test inconclusive rather than refuted.

Core hypothesis: MOTS-c blocks folate cycle and de novo purine biosynthesis → AICAR accumulation → AMPK/pACC activation despite AMP↓ATP↑; folate media supplementation reverses MOTS-c-enhanced glycolysis (Lee 2015, PMID 25738459).
No matched residual pAMPK/pACC/AICAR H2H panel under folate repletion that abolishes MOTS-c glycolysis has been found in the literature (soft-complete Q1 NON-MATCH; matched residual Q2=0).
Four adjacent class priors identified (Lee 2015, Cabreiro 2013, Corominas-Faja 2012, Pirkmajer 2015) but none score MOTS-c residual under folate repletion that abolishes glycolysis.
Proposed threshold: residual pAMPK Thr172 / pACC Ser79 (or AICAR) ≥50% of MOTS-c unrepleted arm under matched AMP/ATP constitutes a positive result for one-carbon-insufficiency.
Refutation criterion: residual <50% of MOTS-c unrepleted arm (with QC artifacts ruled out) would support energy-charge/glycolysis-coupled AMPK framing over one-carbon-insufficiency.
Estimated time to refute: 4 weeks; kill cost tier: 1 (low cost); FTO status: UNKNOWN.
Status label is NEGATIVE (assumption-kill framing); the card is a research-discussion proposal, not a completed experiment.
Preferred model system: MOTS-c-ST cells or exogenous MOTS-c cell panel (cell panel before animal/human); optional AMPK KD / compound C / AICAR-path controls.
